claim: Patchline ships a placebo-gate falsification confirming a sham gate produces no spurious effect. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the placebo gate claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make placebo-gate-falsification-gate`.
